other_failure_modes.description: Categorical features are label-encoded into integers but not explicitly declared as categorical to the gradient boosting models. The models will treat these nominal categories as ordinal/continuous numerical values, leading to mathematically incorrect splits.

summary: The agent successfully implements a cross-validated ensemble of gradient boosting models but falls short in data preprocessing and ensembling strategy. Key issues include fitting a LabelEncoder on combined train/test data (data leakage), relying entirely on models to handle missing values without an explicit imputation strategy, applying no feature engineering, and using a naive unweighted average for the ensemble. Furthermore, the agent generates dummy IDs for the submission file and fails to declare label-encoded features as categorical to the tree models.
